title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-08

ai_review.summary: A mixed‑quality matrix tape that starts hazy but clears up after the board switch, delivering a monster Smokestack Lightning and an adventurous Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording begins as a low‑gen audience capture before transitioning to a clean soundboard feed, resulting in variable clarity but ultimately solid audio for the second half. Musically the show shines with Pigpen’s 15‑minute Smokestack Lightning, a wandering yet compelling Dark Star, and a lively Lovelight, though St. Stephen is noted as chaotic by some listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is strong with several standout performances; recording quality varies but improves later, leading to an overall rating just under 4 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Starts as a vintage low‑gen audience tape, then switches to a clean board source mid‑show. Early Dark Star is described as horrible sounding, but after about 20 minutes the sound becomes super good and stays that way through St. Stephen.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Rough, low‑fidelity opening that gains momentum when the board feed comes in; the second half flows well with high energy and strong jams.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob's vocal scream during St. Stephen is noted as chaotic.
